title: Sampled efficient-frontier rendering fixture

entity_identity.rule: The first column is the stable entity/record ID unless entity_identity states otherwise.
entity_identity.ordering: Source ordinal order is canonical; display sorting, clustering, filtering, and LOD never change source identity.

rng.state: Unsigned 64-bit state initialized to seed modulo 2^64. next_u64 first adds 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 modulo 2^64.
rng.output: z=state; z=(z xor (z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9 mod 2^64; z=(z xor (z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB mod 2^64; return z xor (z>>31).
rng.below: below(n)=next_u64() modulo n for integer n>=1; no rejection sampling.
rng.normal: u1=max(uniform(),1e-12); u2=uniform(); return sqrt(-2*ln(u1))*cos(2*pi*u2). Consume exactly two outputs, discard the sine component, and do not cache normals.
draw_order: Generate 12 expected-return uniforms then 12 volatility uniforms. For each of 2500 portfolios generate 12 uniforms and transform to exponential weights before normalization. No draws for envelope or special portfolios.

normalization.document: One compact JSON object with keys artifact_id, columns, rows; columns contains column IDs and rows contains arrays in manifest column order.
normalization.object_keys: JSON object keys sorted by Unicode code point; no insignificant whitespace; separators are ',' and ':'.
normalization.array_order: Arrays and rows retain manifest/generator order; no sorting unless a formula explicitly requires it.
normalization.numbers: IEEE 754 binary64 results are formatted as base-10 fixed-point with exactly 9 digits after the decimal point, round-to-nearest ties-to-even; no exponent notation.
normalization.integers: JSON integers use base-10 without leading zeroes and are not converted to floating point.
normalization.negative_zero: IEEE -0.0 and any nonzero value rounding to zero at 9 decimals serialize as 0.000000000.
normalization.nonfinite: NaN, +Infinity, and -Infinity are rejected before serialization; null is the only missing/warm-up representation.
normalization.nulls: Missing values serialize as JSON null, never NaN, an empty string, or a sentinel number.
normalization.strings: JSON string escaping per RFC 8259; non-ASCII characters are emitted directly as UTF-8; no locale conversion or Unicode normalization.
normalization.dates: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD strings. Business calendars skip Saturday/Sunday and make no holiday claim.
normalization.datetimes: ISO 8601 UTC strings YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; synthetic intraday sessions are 09:30 through 16:00 exclusive, 390 one-minute bars, weekdays only.
normalization.line_endings: No carriage returns; exactly one LF (0x0A) follows the closing JSON brace; no other trailing bytes.

numeric_oracle.calculation: Compute with IEEE 754 binary64 (and explicit binary32 only for Browser 2 trend) without intermediate 9-decimal rounding. Normalize only for content serialization.
numeric_oracle.display_formatting: Display precision, currency symbols, grouping, and locale are separate. Formula tests may use these tolerances; content hashes require exact normalized bytes.

formulas.portfolios: w[i]=-ln(max(1e-9,u)); sum=sum(w); expected=sum(w*mu)/sum; risk=sqrt(sum(w^2*vol^2))/sum. Weights are retained unnormalized in the artifact; normalized weight is w/sum. This is a diagonal-volatility rendering model, not a covariance QP.
formulas.envelope: vlo/vhi are cloud min/max risk. Forty half-open bins [vlo+(vhi-vlo)*b/40,vlo+(vhi-vlo)*(b+1)/40). Select maximum expected return; ties retain earliest source portfolio. Empty bins have null portfolio/risk/return. The maximum-risk cloud point is intentionally eligible only through special portfolios, matching half-open bin semantics.
formulas.special: minimum-variance and maximum-Sharpe ties retain earliest source index. Sharpe=(return-.02)/risk. Current is fixed risk=.14, return=.065 and is not claimed feasible.
formulas.separation: Sampled envelope and special cloud points are rendering-only. Exact long-only QP, larger clouds, and numerical frontier benchmarks require a separate numerical fixture/revision.

artifacts.description: Random long-only portfolio cloud with twelve weights per row.
All forty sampled-envelope bins including null empty bins.
Minimum variance, maximum Sharpe and fixed current portfolio.

separation_notes: Do not replace this fixture with an exact frontier in rendering parity scenarios; exact numerical demonstrations remain separate.
